description: Apply exp724's NAP-bump recipe (residual NAP=5->6, emb_resid NAP=5->6, out_proj NAP=6->7) at E=192, d_v=32. Fork of exp710 (1.2215 @ 116.39M, E=192, d_v=32, bs=48 16K = 393M tok, default NAPs). Param math: residual_lut /layer 3.15M -> 6.29M (×6 = +18.87M); emb_resid_lut 3.15M -> 6.29M (+3.15M); out_proj /layer 6.29M -> 12.58M (×6 = +37.75M). Expected ~176.16M params (+59.77M vs exp710). Tests if NAP-bump recipe at E=192 matches or beats exp712's 1.2080 @ 179.32M with smaller E. Anchors: exp710=1.2215 @ 116.39M (E=192 baseline); exp712=1.2080 @ 179.32M (E=384 baseline); exp724=1.1936 @ 276.83M (E=384 with NAP-bump).
